title: Help & Support
subtitle: Find answers to your questions or contact us
q1: How do I create a private transfer?
a1: Go to the "Private Transfers" section, fill out the form with recipient details and amount, then confirm the transaction.
a2: Data disclosure allows you to selectively share transaction information with third parties while maintaining control over privacy.
q3: How long does a transfer take to process?
a3: Transfers are typically processed within a few minutes, depending on network congestion.
